_about: Display-name overrides for polities of history.bin (Atlas v2 Phase 4, task 0c; docs/atlas-v2-design.md §7 "Phase 4 — as built"). Cliopatria names a row once for its whole span; where Wikidata carries a DATED name for the same ground, the Atlas shows that name in those years (the label of a Wikidata item whose inception and dissolution dates cover the years). Nothing here is written from memory: `evidence` names the item and its two dates, and audit-polity-names.js refuses an entry whose item is not in the committed Wikidata cache with dates that cover [from, to]. The table is applied at display time (labels, the place card, the stack) and never changes history.bin, a face or a step. Edit this file, then run build-polity-names.js --install.
